- VIRTUA-5-3: Admin updates labs and chemist -> Scenario: Admin updates lab or chemist information
- VIRTUA-5-4: Lab/Chemist information updated successfully -> Covered in the same scenario as VIRTUA-5-3.
- VIRTUA-5-5: Patient updates their personal details -> Scenario: Patient updates their own personal details
- VIRTUA-5-6: Patients details updated successfully -> Covered in the same scenario as VIRTUA-5-5.
- VIRTUA-5-7: Patient creates appointment to visit the doctor (future date) -> Scenario: Patient creates a new appointment for a future date
- VIRTUA-5-8: Appointment is created and can be viewed in appointments tab -> Covered in the same scenario as VIRTUA-5-7.

But note: the requirement VIRTUA-5-8 says "Appointment is created and can be viewed in appointments tab vide Patient Appointment File." So we must check that the appointment appears in the appointments tab.
